articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm for the Canceling of Broadband Multi-path Interference
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel algorithm for the canceling of broadband multi-path interference was presented, namely IBF-ANC (Inverse Beamforming & Adaptive Noise Canceling) combined algorithm. The interference was reconstructed by IBF and used to be the reference at the input end of adaptive noise canceller, which overcame the defect of ANC algorithm. As many practical experiences showed that it was very difficult for ANC algorithm to acquire the exact reference input. Compared with IBF or ANC alone, the combined algorithm could obtain much performance improvement, and the target signal hidden in the strong interference could also be detected, just as the simulation results showed.

articleTitle: Electronic Stamp Model Research
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an electronic stamp model based on anti-spam technologies. The model is composed of spam identifying model and mail receive-filtering model. It takes the mail transmission's establishment as a premise, and applies resource identification technology into it. This model realized the goal of hindering spam from the time of sending, cutting off the spam spreading way, and raising the anti spam efficiency.

articleTitle: The Research on Grid Spatial Database Simulation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem of collaboration and resource sharing of spatial database, this paper combines with the collaboration and resource sharing idea of grid computing, through analyzing the characteristics of grid and spatial database, the author establishes the spatial database model initially in grid environment , studies the spatial data processing operations performance in grid environment and non-grid environment by using simulation, provides a reference of database for the application of grid spatial database.

articleTitle: Case Retrieval Method Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: Case retrieval is a central part in Case-based reasoning (CBR), in order to improve accuracy and efficiency of case retrieval, an improving method based on clustering using of self-organizing maps (SOM) was proposed in this paper. The advantage of this method is Cases' visual clustering result provided by SOM networks greatly facilitating retrieval process and decreasing the retrieval time.

articleTitle: A New Model to Detect Stepping-Stone Intrusion
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: Most researchers do not distinguish stepping-stone detection and stepping-stone intrusion detection, thus introduce more false positive errors in detecting stepping-stone intrusion. Those approaches proposed to detect stepping-stone intrusion are vulnerable to intruders' evasion. In this paper we analyze the problems of the current model used to detect stepping-stone, and propose a new model based on computing the length of an interactive TCP/IP session to detect stepping-stone intrusion. Besides the advantage of low false positive rate, we demonstrate that an approach based on the new model can resist intruders' evasion, such as time-jittering, and chaff-perturbation.

articleTitle: Research of Game of Supply Chain Coordination in the Condition of the Uncertain Delivery
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: The supply chain coordination game in the condition of uncertain delivery is studied, the model of the cost and profit of supplier and producer are proposed, which property of the profit model is concave function and that have maximum. And while, the leader-follower game of Stackelberg between supplier and producer is studied, which is declared that profit obtained by Stackelberg game can be more than completely independent game in the research. The results are indicated that supply chain coordination mechanism can be obtained more profit for the supply chain members.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Evaluation on the Operational Performance of E-commerce Websites Based on Membership Degree Transformation New Algorithm M(1,2,3)
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: The core of fuzzy evaluation on the operational performance of e-commerce websites is membership degree transformation. But the existing transformation methods should be questioned, because redundant data in index membership degree is also used to compute object membership degree, which is not useful for object classification. The new algorithm is: using data mining technology based on entropy to mine knowledge information about object classification hidden in every index, affirm the relationship of object classification and index membership, eliminate the redundant data in index membership for object classification by defining distinguishable weight and extract valid values to compute object membership. The new algorithm of membership degree transformation includes three calculation steps which can be summarized as ¿effective, comparison and composition¿, which is denoted as M(1,2,3). The paper applied the new algorithm in fuzzy evaluation on the operational performance of e-commerce websites.

articleTitle: Analysis of Analog Circuit Subnet Tearing and Mensurability
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: Network torn is a key method in analog circuit fault diagnose. Generally, all torn terminals must be mensurability in implementing network tearing. In accordance with the restrictions, presenting partition conditions of solvable subnet those partial torn terminals inaccessible, this paper analyze mensurability of subnet to lay the groundwork of further fault location.

articleTitle: Study Chaos Double-Mutations Cooperation Particles Swarm Optimization and Application in Order-Type Vulcanization Workshop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the features of order-type vulcanization workshop scheduling, deficiencies of PSO, as well as the excellent characteristics of the chaos principle, target mutations, and cooperation particles, a new particle swarm optimization algorithm, that is, chaos double-mutations cooperation particles swarm optimization was proposed. This can maintain the diversity of particles, avoid results falling into local optimum and improve the algorithm's global search ability. Four optimization algorithm convergences were compared and the change orders of vulcanization workshop scheduling were stimulated by testing. Results show that it is very effective and the chaos double-mutations cooperation particles swarm optimization in solving the order-type vulcanization workshop scheduling was verified.

articleTitle: Research of 3-Phase Reversible Rectifier Based on Current Hysteresis Regulator
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the control requirement and actual project condition of three-phase high power factor rectifier, for the sake of eliminating inconstant switching frequency in the converter that brought on rather serious power supply harmonic pollution and shock damage of power devices and reducing difficulty of filter circuit design, based on these problems the constant switching frequency control algorithm adopting current hysteresis regulator was put forward. It combines their respective advance of current hysteresis control and constant switching frequency strategy, enhanced the system's dynamic response and well robust character, and minimized its switching loss. In terms of simulation results analysis, and construction of an experimental prototype based on DSP TMS320F2812, both of them verified the validity and superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Machine Assignment of Steelmaking and Continuous Casting Based on Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: The machine assignment problem of steelmaking and continuous casting (SCC) is key for making optimization scheduling plan. The machine assignment strategy of SCC scheduling plan is studied in this paper, the dynamic programming model of machine assignment is established based on production constraints, production cost and processing time. The results tested by production data show the rationality and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimum Design of Throttle-Valves Parameters for Shock Absorber Based on Velocity Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: Throttle-valves parameters affect the characteristic of shock absorber, but at present, there is not any accurate and reliable analytic design method. In this paper, analyzed the various damping factors that affect the design of throttle-valves parameters, the design model of throttle-valves parameters by single velocity was founded, by the analytic formula of throttle-slice deformation and the relation of throttle-pressure with flux. Based on this, defined a target function, the optimization design method of throttle-valves parameters of curve fitting was established. A practical design example of throttle-valves parameters of one shock absorber followed, with this method. The designed results of throttle-valves parameters were compared with that shown on the blueprint of factory. The performance test was conducted for the telescopic shock absorber designed. The experiment results show that the model and method of optimization design for the throttle-valves parameters are reliable.

articleTitle: Digital Oil Field Data Management Based on Data Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of Internet and computation technique, many areas begin to process their own area data more accurately. Especially, oil field area involves many disciplinary area data, such as physical geography disciplinary, geological disciplinary, reservoir engineering disciplinary and so on, data from simple character type to complex bulk data volume type. How to effectively manage these distributed data is always a hot potato for the oil field companies, recently, many oil companies begin to construct their own data center, however, only some topic data for research is stored in data center, it does not implement real uniform data management. Data grid technique is proposed for solving these issues, it regards data management issues as service management, and it solves data management issues puzzled people. According to these facts, a digital oil field framework based on data grid technique is proposed. We think this framework is able to solve oil field data management issues and provide all kinds of users with interested data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Improved Routing Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Workshop on Computer Science and Engineering
abstract: How to get high efficient data routing for the limited energy resource networks is an important problem in the study of the wireless sensor networks. An improved routing algorithm for data aggregation based on ant colony algorithm (IACAR) is presented. The ant colony system provides a natural and intrinsic way of exploring search space in determining data aggregation. Every ant will explore all possible paths from the source node to the sink node. Simulation results show that proposed algorithm can reduce significant energy costs.
